platform.name: Optimizely
platform.tagline: Managed cloud and 24/7 support for Optimizely
platform.intro: Optimizely blends content management with commerce and experimentation — a powerful combination that needs to be 'always on' for the brands running on it.
platform.problem: Experimentation platforms live and die by trust: if the marketing team suspects a test is misfiring or the CMS is slow, the whole programme stalls while engineers investigate from scratch.
platform.solution: Our engineers keep Optimizely platforms healthy — content, commerce and experimentation layers — so your team can trust the data, ship campaigns on schedule and never wonder whether the platform is the problem.

features.title: Experimentation reliability
features.text: We watch the runtime and integrations behind your tests, so a misbehaving snippet never quietly corrupts your results.

features.title: Faster feature delivery
